title: Bandits abduct 47 Niger women, others harvesting groundnuts
summary: By Clare Nnabuike, Minna MINNA — No fewer than 47 people, mostly women, have been abducted by suspected bandits while harvesting groundnuts on farms in Mariga Local Government Area of Niger State. The incident occurred on Saturday at Tungan Rimi in Ma’undu-Beri Ward of the council area. The victims were said to have been working on their farms when the armed men invaded the area and took them into the forest.

title: Niger Soldiers Killed in Fighting Near Mali Border
summary: Several Nigerien soldiers have been killed in a clash with heavily armed fighters near the border with Mali, an area affected by persistent terrorist violence. The Defence Ministry did not provide an exact death toll but said the fighters involved were “mercenaries”, a term authorities in the junta-led country use to refer to terrorists. The ministry said the fighting occurred around 6:30 am on Wednesday near Fartel in the western Tillaberi region, when soldiers attempting to intercept stolen livestock encountered a large group of heavily armed fighters travelling on motorcycles.
